zh-CN.Woodworkers often budget the plywood and: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.Material is usually the largest line. Es: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.Hardware is the line people underestimat: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.Glue, screws, sandpaper, and finish are: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Mistakes happen: a miscut part, a wrong: Mistakes happen: a miscut part, a wrong hardware order, a damaged sheet. A sensible contingency, often around ten to fifteen percent, absorbs those without blowing the budget. Build the estimate by category, add the contingency, and you have a number you can commit to. Then track actual versus estimate to improve the next project's budget.
